title: U-Net real-time video model diagnoses chronic atrophic gastritis at endoscopy
summary: A U-Net deep learning model for real-time endoscopic video was tested in a prospective nested case-control study of 1539 patients, with pathology as reference. After propensity score matching, the model outperformed endoscopists in sensitivity (84.02% vs 62.72%), specificity (97.04% vs 81.95%) and AUC (0.909 vs 0.740). The study is registered as ChiCTR2100044458; results come from a propensity-matched subset, and the abstract does not describe a multicenter design.
ai_technology: U-Net deep learning real-time video monitoring model

evidence.tested: Prospective nested case-control evaluation of the model against pathological diagnosis and endoscopists.
evidence.unknown: Performance outside the study site and effect on patient outcomes; full text not reviewed.
